vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (thinking events) > produces the same materialised messages as the reasoning equivalents
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes: a retired shape is translated into its replacement before enforcement, not dropped (DEPRECATIONS.md: THINKING_* -> REASONING_*)
vectors.notes: TS asserts the reducer's materialised messages equal those of the same stream spelled in REASONING_* (ids scrubbed); the vector asserts the translated events that produce them. REASONING_START and REASONING_MESSAGE_START ids are minted by the boundary (random UUIDs in TS, and the span and the message get DIFFERENT ids); the vector checks them only for consistency via $bind. THINKING_TEXT_MESSAGE_START translates with role 'reasoning'. TS drives agent.runAgent (boundary installed innermost).

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (thinking events) > translates exactly once even when a version-gated 0045 is also installed
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes: a retired shape is translated into its replacement before enforcement, not dropped (DEPRECATIONS.md: THINKING_* -> REASONING_*)
vectors.notes: TS runs against a peer whose maxVersion is 0.0.45, so the version-gated BackwardCompatibility_0_0_45 middleware is installed too; it asserts exactly one REASONING_START and no THINKING_START reaches subscribers. The Ruby pipeline is built with middleware: [], so only the boundary translates; the protocol-level outcome is the same: one translation. REASONING_START and REASONING_MESSAGE_START ids are minted by the boundary (random UUIDs in TS, and the span and the message get DIFFERENT ids); the vector checks them only for consistency via $bind.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (legacy binary content) > upgrades binary parts inside an inbound messages snapshot
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes (DEPRECATIONS.md: {type: binary} input content part -> media parts with a source, on requests AND response events)
vectors.notes: TS asserts the snapshot's content becomes [text, {type: image, source: {type: data, value, mimeType}}] and that a warning names 'binary input content'.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (legacy nulls) > converts %s null to absent, end to end [TOOL_CALL_START.parentMessageId]
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes (DEPRECATIONS.md optional-null table): a whole optional null is read as an absent field, before validation
vectors.notes: TS asserts the delivered TOOL_CALL_START carries no null parentMessageId and that a warning mentions 'null'.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (legacy nulls) > converts %s null to absent, end to end [TOOL_CALL_CHUNK.parentMessageId]
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes (DEPRECATIONS.md optional-null table): a whole optional null is read as an absent field, before validation
vectors.notes: TS asserts the delivered TOOL_CALL_CHUNK carries no null parentMessageId and that a warning mentions 'null'. The null must be gone before the chunk is enforced and expanded: the boundary sees the RAW chunk.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (legacy nulls) > converts %s null to absent, end to end [RUN_FINISHED.outcome]
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes (DEPRECATIONS.md optional-null table): a whole optional null is read as an absent field, before validation
vectors.notes: TS asserts the delivered RUN_FINISHED carries no null outcome and that a warning mentions 'null'.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (legacy nulls) > a null VALUE under a metadata key is data and survives untouched
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/metadata (DEPRECATIONS.md: a null value under a metadata key is data, never an absence)
vectors.notes: TS asserts STEP_STARTED.metadata is delivered as {finishReason: null}.

vectors.name: the boundary on the connect/subscribe path > translates thinking events arriving through connectAgent
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes: a retired shape is translated into its replacement before enforcement, not dropped (DEPRECATIONS.md: THINKING_* -> REASONING_*); /spec/1.0/basic/processing#where-middleware-sits: the ordering applies on every path, reconnection and replay included
vectors.notes: TS drives connectAgent (the connect path applies the boundary as a plain operator, no middleware chain); asserts a REASONING_START arrives and no THINKING_START. One pipeline in Ruby, so this collapses to the same stream as the run path. REASONING_START and REASONING_MESSAGE_START ids are minted by the boundary (random UUIDs in TS, and the span and the message get DIFFERENT ids); the vector checks them only for consistency via $bind.

vectors.name: the boundary sees raw chunks (before chunk transformation) > converts a null parentMessageId on a continuation chunk too
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes (DEPRECATIONS.md optional-null table): a whole optional null is read as an absent field, before validation; /spec/1.0/basic/processing#where-middleware-sits: the compatibility boundary MUST see the stream first, because a retired shape can be a chunk
vectors.notes: TS asserts a TOOL_CALL_START is delivered and a warning mentions 'null'. Continuation chunks lose their extra fields in expansion, so the boundary must convert (and announce) the null on the raw chunk before expansion runs.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (what the translation costs) > says that a THINKING_START title is dropped
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/versioning#retired-shapes: a translation that loses content in the process MUST warn
vectors.notes: TS asserts only the warning text (it names THINKING_START.title and the value 'Working'); the delivered REASONING_START carries no title. REASONING_START and REASONING_MESSAGE_START ids are minted by the boundary (random UUIDs in TS, and the span and the message get DIFFERENT ids); the vector checks them only for consistency via $bind.

vectors.name: the inbound compatibility boundary (what the translation costs) > says that it minted an id for a continuation with no opener
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/basic/patterns/streaming#open-content-close: a content event for an identifier that is not open is a violation
vectors.notes: TS asserts rejects.toThrow(/REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT/): verification refuses the translated content event because nothing opened the id the boundary had to mint (TS message: "Cannot send 'REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT' event: No active reasoning message found with ID '<minted uuid>'..."). The id is random, so only the event type is a stable fragment. Warnings: the mint is announced, naming THINKING_TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT.
